published_prior_art.cite: IglesiasAlonsoEtAl2025 gives a deficient-channel counterexample, not an interior full-observed-law perturbation converse with injective M.
ZhangLiMiaoTchetgen2023 supplies bridge-fiber functional uniqueness, while IglesiasAlonsoEtAl2025 supplies only the full-rank sufficient condition.
IglesiasAlonsoEtAl2025 Assumption 1 and Theorem 1 are the full-source-rank comparator; the explicit deficient-rank witness is a useful strictness corollary.
DufourTaamouti2005 establishes projection-based weak-IV inference; the proposed Hoeffding-projection set is a transport-specific finite-sample implementation.
AndrewsGuggenberger2019 provides singularity-robust moment-condition inference but not this unrestricted two-sample balancing-fiber formulation.

soundness_flags.one_line: The requested n^{-1/2} diameter is undefined because the triangular array specifies neither n=n_s+n_t nor an asymptotic allocation condition such as n_s/n→p∈(0,1).

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v2, marked by the authors as the final NeurIPS 2025 camera-ready version
source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Assumption 1 and Theorem 1, equation (4); Appendix B.2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 1 requires rank(P(W|E,x))≥|U|, Theorem 1 gives P(Y|E,x)P(W|E,x)^†Q(W), and Appendix B.2's failure construction has rank(P(W|U))<|U|.
The paper studies identification and inference for counterfactual means with nonunique bridge solutions and distinguishes uniqueness from root-n estimability.

The work concerns robust prediction under latent shift with imperfect proxies and a cross-domain rank condition over latent-equivalent-class mixture weights; it is not archival causal-intervention theorem text.
The cited paper exists with the stated title, venue, year, and pagination and is a linear-structural-model projection-inference comparator.

The paper supplies identification- and singularity-robust AR/CQLR inference; its subvector section treats nuisance parameters and initially assumes strongly identified nuisance parameters and nonsingular moment variance.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 2024, pp. 1778-1793
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 reduces discrete causal bounding to polynomial optimization and the article describes valid progressively refined nonsharp bounds.
The article establishes proxy-based causal identification under rank conditions without identifying the proxy measurement mechanism.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Machine Learning Research 24(188), 2023, pp. 1-46
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The Proximal ID Algorithm joins graphical ID with proxy-based identification and includes estimation strategies in a special case.
The paper studies root-n inference for strongly identified linear functionals of weakly identified nuisance functions and proposes debiased estimators.
The paper provides partial-identification methods for proxy-confounding settings without completeness rather than the shared-channel transport fiber.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the triangular-array sampling regime explicitly: set n=n_s+n_t and require n_s/n→p∈(0,1), then state uniform coverage and diameter using a liminf-over-arrays formulation.

Promote the full-law converse as the headline and give an explicit algorithm that tests target-span membership and returns either a balancing functional or the separator-driven nonidentification certificate.

Develop the deferred off-span sharp-set problem into attained endpoint bounds with a transport-specific reduction or certificate, which would turn non-singleton failure into a materially stronger partial-identification contribution.

recommended_next_step: Repair the triangular-array sampling definition in the open-ended inference question, then advance the target-span iff and full-law converse kernel to Stage 0.
